m: त्यद् mfn. nom. स्य (स्), स्या, त्यद्, (g. सर्वादि) that (often used like an article, e.g. त्यत् पणीनां वसु, ‘that i.e. the wealth of the Paṇis’, RV. ix, 111, 2; sometimes strengthened by चिद्; often put after उत, or after another demonstrative in the beginning of a sentence), RV.; AV. vii, 14, 1; ŚBr. xiv (त्यस्य = मम, 4, 1, 26; n. त्यम् for त्यद्, 5, 3, 1 and [in the etymology of सत्यम्] KauṣUp.), TUp. ii, 6

त्यग्नायिस् N. of a Sāman, Lāṭy.

1. त्यज् cl. 1. ˚जति (metrically also ˚ते; pf. Ved. तित्याज, Class. तत्˚, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 36; तत्यज, BhP. iii, 4; fut. त्यक्ष्यति, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 10; Kār.; त्यजिष्य्˚, R. ii, vii; MārkP.; aor. अत्याक्षीत्; inf. त्यक्तुम्) to leave, abandon, quit, RV. x, 71, 6; Mn.; MBh. &c.; to leave a place, go away from, Mn. vi, 77; MBh. &c.; to let go, dismiss, discharge, VarBṛS. xvii, 22; Bhaṭṭ.; to give up, surrender, resign, part from, renounce, ĪśUp. 1; Mn.; MBh. &c. (तनुम् or देहम् or कलेवरम्, ‘to abandon the body, die’, Mn. vi; MBh. &c.; प्राणान् or श्वासम् or जीवितम्, ‘to give up breath or life, risk or lose one's life’, MBh.; R. &c.); P. Ā. to shun, avoid, get rid of, free one's self from (any passion &c.), MBh. &c.; to give away, distribute, offer (as a sacrifice or oblation to a deity; त्यजते etymologically = σέβεται), Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.; to set aside, leave unnoticed, disregard, ŚāṅkhŚr.; Mn. iii; MBh. i, 3098; Hit. ii, 3, 30; (ind.p. त्यक्त्वा) to except, VarBṛS.; Caurap., Sch.; Pass. त्यज्यते, to be abandoned by, get rid of (instr.), Pañcat. i, 10, 0/1 : Caus. त्याजयति (aor. अतित्यजत्, Bhaṭṭ.) to cause anyone to quit, MBh. xiii, 288; to cause anyone to give up, Kathās. lxxxiii, 34; to expel, turn out, xx, 126; to cause any one to lose, deprive of (instr.), Bhaṭṭ. xv, 120; to empty the body by evacuations, Bhpr. : Desid. तित्यक्षति, to be about to lose (one's life, प्राणान्), Car. v, 10 and 12.
2. त्यज् mfn. ifc. leaving, abandoning, W.
giving up, offering, BhP. viii; Rājat. iv

a: त्यज् — {c1c} P. (त्यजति, तत्याज, अत्याक्षीत्, त्यक्ष्यति, त्यक्त) 1 To leave (in all senses), abandon, quit, go away from; वर्त्म भानोस्त्यजाशु Me. 39; Ms. 6. 77, 9. 177; Ś. 5. 26. --2 To let go, dismiss, discharge; Bk. 6. 122. --3 To give up, renounce, resign, surrender; Bh. 3. 16; Ms. 2. 95, 6. 33; Bg. 6. 24, 16. 21. --4 To shun, avoid. --5 To get rid of, free oneself from; Bg. 2. 3. --6 To set aside, disregard; त इमेऽवस्थिता युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा धनानि च Bg. 1. 33. --7 To except. --8 To distribute, give away; कृतं (संचयं) आश्वयुजे त्यजेत् Y. 3. 47; Ms. 6. 15. --9 To shoot off. --Caus. 1 To cause to give up &c., to deprive (a person) of anything. --2 To expel, turn out. --3 To quit. --Desid. (तित्यक्षति) To wish to leave &c.

m: त्यक्त mfn. left, abandoned.
a: त्यक्त — p. p. [त्यज् कर्मणि-क्त] 1 Abandoned, forsaken, left, quitted. --2 Resigned, surrendered. --3 Shunned, avoided; see त्यज्. --Comp. --अग्निः a Brāhmaṇa who has given up household fire. --जीवित, --प्राण a. ready to abandon life, willing to run any risk; मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः Bg. 1. 9. --लज्ज a. shameless.

k.v: त्यक्तं हीनं विधुतं समुज्झितं धूतमुत्सृष्टे। उक्तं भाषितमुदितं जल्पितमाख्यातमभिहितं लपितम्.।

त्यक्त—लज्ज mfn. abandoning shame, shameless, BhP. v, 26, 23.
त्यक्त—प्राण mfn. id., MBh. v, 7204.
त्यक्त—पुनः-स्वि-कृत (in rhet.) resuming what has been suspended, Kpr.
त्यक्त—वत् mfn. having left.
त्यक्त—विधि mfn. transgressing rules, ix, 6, 9.

to be kept off from (abl.), VarBṛS.
to be given up or sacrificed, MBh. i, 6183 and 6195; R.
to be given up in despair, Subh.

one who abandons or sacrifices (his life, प्राणान्), MBh. vii, 378.

[d] klI, (tyaj + “tyajitanIti .” uRAM । 1 । 131 । iti adiH sa ca qit .) vAyuH । AkASaH । yaTA, -- “satyavrataM satyaparaM trisatyaM sattyasya yoniM nihitaYca sattye । sattyasya satyamftasatyanetraM satyAtmakaM tvAM SaraRaM prapannAH ॥” iti BAgavate । 10 । 2 । 26 ॥ “satyavratamiti । satyaM vrataM saNkalpo yasya tam । satyaparaM satyaM paraM SrezWaM prAptisADanaM yasmin tam । trisatyaM trizvapi kAlezu sfzweH pUrvvaM pralayAnantaraM sTitisamaye ca satyaM avyaBicAreRa varttamAnam । tadevAhuH sattyasya yonimiti । sacCabdena pfTivyaptejAMsi tyacCabdena vAyvAkASO evaM sacca tyacca sattyaM BUtapaYcakam । ‘tat sattyamityAcakzate .’ iti SruteH । tasya yoniM kAraRam । anena sfzweH pUrvvaM varttamAnatoktA । taTA sattye tasminneva nihitaM antaryAmitayA sTitam । anena sTitisamaye'pi satyatvamuktam । taTA mattyasya satyaM tasyEva sattyasya satyaM pAramArTikaM nASe'pyavaSizyamARarUpam । anena pralaye'pyavaDitve na satyatvaM darSitam । evaM trisatyatvamupapAditam । taTA ftasatyanetraM ftaM sUnftA vARI satyaM samadarSanam । taTA BagavatA vyAKyAsya mAnatvAt । satyaYca samadarSanam । ftaYca sUnftA, vARI kaviBiH parikIrttitA iti । tayornetraM nayanasADanaM netAraM pravarttakamiti yAvat । evaM sarvvaprakAreRa satyAtmakaM tvAM vayaM SaraRaM prapannA ityarTaH .” iti tawwIkAyAM SrIDarasvAmI ॥
